rule: Give every section a different arrangement from its neighbours, using the dealt shapes instead of one repeated block.
Keep a card-sort deck to 30–50 cards so participants stay engaged and sort thoughtfully.
Spend colour on the data itself, not on the shell and chrome of the app screen.
Set KPIs as typographic figures with a plain label, never as tiles carrying icon chips or sparklines.
Separate cards with a 1px rule or one tone step instead of a drop shadow.
Print zeros as zeros, missing values as a grey dash, and keep an empty section's frame.
Write error messages in plain language that name the problem and suggest a fix.
